description: Reads and summarizes a Jira ticket in the IDF project. Use this skill whenever a user mentions a Jira ticket key (IDF-XXXX) and wants to read or understand it. Does NOT implement code — use the `implement-ticket` skill for that. Does NOT create tickets — use the `create-ticket` skill for that. Trigger on: "lis le ticket IDF-XXXX", "résume le ticket IDF-XXXX", "qu'est-ce que dit le ticket IDF-XXXX", "montre-moi le ticket IDF-XXXX", or any mention of an IDF-XXXX key without an implementation intent. Requires Jira MCP (sooperset/mcp-atlassian) to be configured.
